title: The Diverse Transformer (Trf) Protein Family in the Sea Urchin Paracentrotus lividus Acts through a Collaboration between Cellular and Humoral Immune Effector Arms.
authors: Yakovenko, Iryna; Donnyo, Asaf; Ioscovich, Or; Rosental, Benyamin; Oren, Matan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海胆Transformer蛋白家族的免疫效应功能，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Sea urchins are long-living marine invertebrates with a complex innate immune system, which includes expanded families of immune receptors. A central immune gene family in sea urchins encodes the Transformer (Trf) proteins. The Trf family has been studied mainly in the purple sea urchin Strongylocentrotus purpuratus. Here, we explore this protein family in the Mediterranean Sea urchin Paracentrotus lividus. The PlTrf genes and predicted proteins are highly diverse and show a typical Trf size range and structure. Coelomocytes and cell-free coelomic fluid from P. lividus contain different PlTrf protein repertoires with a shared subset, that bind specifically to E. coli. Using FACS, we identified five different P. lividus coelomocyte sub-populations with cell surface PlTrf protein expression. The relative abundance of the PlTrf-positive cells increases sharply following immune challenge with E. coli, but not following challenge with LPS or the sea urchin pathogen, Vibrio penaeicida. Phagocytosis of E. coli by P. lividus phagocytes is mediated through the cell-free coelomic fluid and is inhibited by blocking PlTrf activity with anti-SpTrf antibodies. Together, our results suggest a collaboration between cellular and humoral PlTrf-mediated effector arms in the P. lividus specific immune response to pathogens.
abstract_zh: 海胆是长寿的海洋无脊椎动物，拥有复杂的先天免疫系统，其中包括扩增的免疫受体家族。海胆中的一个核心免疫基因家族编码Transformer (Trf) 蛋白。Trf家族主要在紫色海胆 *Strongylocentrotus purpuratus* 中进行了研究。在此，我们探索了地中海海胆 *Paracentrotus lividus* 中的这一蛋白家族。*PlTrf* 基因和预测蛋白高度多样，并显示出典型的Trf大小范围和结构。来自 *P. lividus* 的体腔细胞和无细胞体腔液含有不同的PlTrf蛋白库，并共享一个子集，这些蛋白能特异性结合 *E. coli*。利用FACS，我们鉴定了 *P. lividus* 的五个不同体腔细胞亚群，其细胞表面表达PlTrf蛋白。在 *E. coli* 免疫挑战后，PlTrf阳性细胞的相对丰度急剧增加，但在LPS或海胆病原体 *Vibrio penaeicida* 挑战后则无此变化。*P. lividus* 吞噬细胞对 *E. coli* 的吞噬作用通过无细胞体腔液介导，并通过抗SpTrf抗体阻断PlTrf活性而被抑制。综合来看，我们的结果表明，在 *P. lividus* 对病原体的特异性免疫反应中，细胞和体液PlTrf介导的效应臂之间存在协作。
